cards.card_text: Timothy has served with Paul like a child with his father, to advance the gospel.

cards.card_text: Even after what happened in Philippi, Paul says his team was bold in God to speak the gospel in Thessalonica.
cards.verse_text: But in the face of strong opposition, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God.
cards.snippet: …opposition, we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel of God.

cards.card_text: Instead, they speak as people God approved and entrusted with the gospel.
cards.verse_text: Instead, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.
cards.snippet: …we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel, not in order to please men but God, who examines our hearts.

cards.card_text: Paul says his team cared so deeply that they were delighted to share the gospel of God and their own ___ as well.
cards.verse_text: We cared so deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well.
cards.snippet: …deeply that we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God, but our own lives as well.

cards.card_text: Paul and his team worked night and day while they proclaimed the gospel in Thessalonica.
cards.verse_text: We worked night and day so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
cards.snippet: …not be a burden to anyone while we proclaimed to you the gospel of God.
